value.name: Whitfield reviews Devin's signature
value.description: Whitfield lifts the page to read Devin's full signature and then squares the document away, signaling he intends to keep it.
evidence: Whitfield finally moved his hand, lifting the page just enough to read Devin's signature in full, and then set it back down squared to the edge of his blotter the way he squared every document he intended to keep.

value.name: Whitfield thanks Asha before the meeting
value.description: Whitfield thanks Asha for bringing the document before the meeting, and Asha reads his wording as a sign that the procedural issue is accepted and the personal matter will stay private.
evidence: "Thank you for bringing this to me before the meeting," he said, and the word he chose was thank you, not we'll discuss, which Asha understood to mean the procedural piece had landed where she needed it to land and the personal piece had been heard and would not be repeated out loud in the next room.

value.name: Whitfield warns Asha about the meeting timing
value.description: Whitfield checks the time and tells Asha she needs to be in her chair before Hatcher's name is raised.
evidence: He glanced at the clock on the credenza. "Six-forty. You'll want to be in your chair before Hatcher's name comes up."

value.name: Asha leaves Whitfield's office
value.description: Asha takes the returned copy and exits into the corridor, heading toward the upcoming conference meeting.
evidence: She nodded, took the copy he slid back toward her, and let herself out into the corridor

value.name: Asha anticipates difficult hearing discussion
value.description: As she walks out, Asha mentally braces for a conference where she must defend the firm's Hatcher placement while exhausted and financially strained.
evidence: where, in eighteen minutes, she would have to sit across a conference table from the woman whose children's hearing was at ten, with a night of no sleep behind her and an empty savings account, and explain why the firm's strategy for the Hatcher placement still held.

value.name: Asha pauses to steady herself
value.description: In the corridor, Asha stops, closes her eyes, and deliberately calms herself so she can enter the conference room composed.
evidence: In the corridor outside Whitfield's office, Asha stopped walking. She closed her eyes for the count of five, felt the floor under her shoes and the dry burn behind her eyelids from the night she had not slept, and let her breath find a rhythm she could carry into the conference room.

value.name: Rosa sends Asha encouragement
value.description: Asha receives a brief text from Rosa telling her to go win, giving her a small boost before the meeting.
evidence: When she opened her eyes the phone at her hip buzzed once: Rosa, two words, Go. Win.

value.name: Asha pockets Rosa's message
value.description: Asha reads Rosa's message and puts the phone away, preparing to continue toward the meeting.
evidence: She read it, slid the phone back into her
